how.title: How it works
how.s1: Take a photo of the problem — pothole, garbage, broken light…
how.s2: AI suggests a category and description. You review and edit it.
how.s3: Add the location and submit. You get a unique complaint ID.
how.s4: Follow your complaint until it is resolved.

why.title: Why CIVICCARE?
why.s1: Big buttons, clear words, large text — made for first-time smartphone users.
why.s2: AI helps write your complaint — but you always review and confirm before submitting.
why.s3: Your reports are visible only to you. We never display personal details publicly.
